transistor_episode_published_trigger.description: Runs each time an episode is published in Transistor. Ones published before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, type, attributes, relationships

transistor_new_episode_trigger.description: Runs for each new episode in Transistor. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, type, attributes, relationships

transistor_new_subscriber_trigger.description: Runs for each new private subscriber in Transistor. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, type, attributes, relationships
